name: qaqa_search
description: Use this for current events, recent versions, prices, exchange rates, weather, or anything you're unsure about. It searches multiple engines, fetches the relevant pages, and returns clean snippets. Cite results as [1], [2] in your answer and verify numbers/dates against the returned content (the 'answer' field is a fragment of content, not a verified answer - do not repeat it without checking). Prefer results with a published_at or updated_at date for freshness questions (both null = no date; updated_at = last modification, not publication). If results are empty or meta.confidence is low/none, say you couldn't find it - do not fill the gap from your own knowledge. meta.fallback=true means raw results existed but none were relevant - treat as not found. Supports Azerbaijani and English queries. Weather/time/currency queries return exact structured data (Open-Meteo / CBAR).

query.description: Axtarış sualı. Azərbaycan və ya İngilis dilində yaz.

max_chars.description: Ümumi mətn limiti. Default 4000, min 500, max 8000.

format.description: json = tək JSON obyekt (default), jsonl = hər sətir JSON (stream), simple = yalnız title/url/snippet (əhatəli LLM tool çağırışı üçün)

freshness.description: Təzilik filtri - yalnız bu müddət daxilində nəşr olunmuş nəticələr (təzə xəbər sualları üçün, məs. 'week').
